title: REQ · HeaderOverlay has loading, empty and error states explaining round API failure
summary: HeaderOverlay shows loading, empty and error states with a failure explanation
description: Context: RoundBadge currently shows 'Round unavailable' with no reason. Desired behavior: loading=true shows 'Loading round…'; error set shows 'Round unavailable: <error>' in role=alert; no round, no error and not loading shows 'No active round'. Logo, world name and controls stay visible in all states. Expected result: failure is explained. Why: users must understand why no round is shown.
acceptance_criteria: Given loading true, When rendered, Then 'Loading round…' is shown and no timer is present
Given error 'Round service returned 500', When rendered, Then a role=alert contains that text
Given loading false, error undefined, round undefined, When rendered, Then 'No active round' is shown

in_scope: Three non-ready states and their precedence: error over loading over empty
preserve: Logo and controls visible in all states

definition_of_done: All three states render distinct text
